literal_meaning: ঘরে আগুন জ্বালানো (to light a fire in the house)
figurative_meaning_bn: পরিজনদের ধ্বংসসাধন করা; সংসারের শান্তি নষ্ট করা
figurative_meaning_en: To cause destruction to family members; to ruin the peace of the household
similar_in_english: to stir up trouble at home
to sow discord in the family
example_sentences_in_bangla: নতুন বউ এসে ঘরে আগুন দিচ্ছে।
example_sentences_in_english: His words have set the house on fire.
The new bride is stirring up trouble in the home.
note: Often used in contexts of marital or familial discord, evoking traditional Bengali household tensions.
